name: Kurogane Otome
source:
Otome is a third year student from class 3-A. Otome is a descendant of a mighty warrior. She is a master of [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kenp%C5%8D]kenpo[/url] and she has a superhuman athletic capability. At the school, she is the student council vice-president and the chair of the disciplinary committee. [url=http://vndb.org/c61]Erika[/url] cannot disobey her. She has some weak points as she is a poor cook, is not good with mechanical appliances and hates thunder. She made a promise to Leo in their childhood that she will always protect him.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsuyokiss]Wikipedia[/url]]

In 2gakki her bust size went up from 83 to 85.
